#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

long long gcdLL(long long a, long long b) {
    while (b != 0) {
        long long temp = b;
        b = a % b;
        a = temp;
    }
    return a;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int a, b, n;
    cin >> a >> b >> n;
    int best_num = 0, best_den = 1;
    double min_diff = INFINITY;

    for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
        int start_i = (j * a) / b - 1;
        int end_i = (j * a) / b + 1;
        for (int i = start_i; i <= end_i; ++i) {

            if (current_diff < min_diff) {
                min_diff = current_diff;
                best_num = i;
                best_den = j;
            }
        }
    }
    int g = gcdLL(abs(best_num), best_den);
    cout << best_num / g << "/" << best_den / g;
    return 0;
}
